title: Kvarðinn page component diagram
description: The page in the browser: main.ts renders the screen from the room's latest View, the scale is one element that survives re-renders so a drag is never interrupted, and net.ts keeps one WebSocket to the room open across drops and refreshes.

components.name: Kvarðinn page
components.responsibility: Everything that runs in the browser.

components.name: Screens (main.ts)
components.responsibility: Routes on the hash; the front page (POST api/rooms), join and seat claim, lobby with link and QR code, the round screens, the end screen and the big screen; sends actions and shows errors as toasts.

components.name: Connection (net.ts)
components.responsibility: One WebSocket to ws/CODE that reconnects with back-off, on visibility and on coming online; says hello with the saved seat; pings every 25 s; stops on gone. loadSeat and saveSeat keep the seat per room.

components.name: Scale (scale.ts)
components.responsibility: The bar between the card's ends, the draggable pointer with pointer, keyboard and nudge controls, and the scoring bands for the giver and after the reveal.

components.name: Sound (sound.ts)
components.responsibility: Web Audio tones for the reveal and the points; off when the player turns it off on this device.

components.name: Text (text.ts)
components.responsibility: The game's name, the how-to-play lines, HTML escaping and the points label.

components.name: Rules
components.responsibility: The View, Action and team types, the text limits, goals and round counts, and the scoring bands.

components.name: Worker and rooms
components.responsibility: Creates the room and holds its game.

relationships.description: Opens a Connection per room and sends join, claim and act messages through it; the Connection says hello itself.
Moves the one Scale element into each screen, sends its drags as move actions, and holds a redraw until a drag ends.
Unlocks audio on a tap and plays the reveal.
The sweep while the target is uncovered.
BANDS, to draw the scoring bands.
POST api/rooms for a new room.
